title: L2Verification (l2_verification.v1)
description: Story 3.6 structured verification verdict (FR23). AUTHORITATIVE validation source for the L2 sub-agent response contract; l2_verification.yaml is the human-readable mirror and internal/decision/analyst/l2_verification_schema.json is the byte-identical embedded runtime copy. schema_version is optional (or null) on the model side: the L2 runner force-stamps l2_verification.v1 after validation. The referential rule that every verified_evidence event_id must exist in the input EvidencePackage, and the whitespace-only rejection of finding and contradictory_findings entries, are enforced programmatically by the runner. Size bounds on every model-controlled field follow the Story 3.5 round-1 convention so a hostile or runaway reply cannot relay unbounded content into checkpointing, audit, or the Senior prompt.

schema_version.description: Stamped to l2_verification.v1 by the runner; optional (or null) from the model.

verdict.description: The L2 verdict on the L1 hypothesis (FR23 closed set).

verified_evidence.description: Evidence-by-evidence verification narrative over events from the input package.

event_id.description: Event.ID of the examined event; must exist in the input package (runner-enforced).

finding.description: Verification narrative for this event; whitespace-only is rejected by the runner.

contradictory_findings.description: Findings that contradict the L1 hypothesis; preserved verbatim for the Senior's challenge (AC3).
